annotations.title: Find AI tools for a job

description: Find AI tools that fit a described job, from the INITE Atlas - ten thousand tools re-read every week, ranked by measured use rather than votes. Describe the job in a sentence or two with any constraint that matters (self-hosted, an API, a free plan, a budget, who will use it). Returns up to five tools, each with which stated requirements it meets, which it does not, and which were not measured. No overall match percentage on purpose: the answers are typed, not scored. Free; twenty a day per address or account.

need.description: What the tool has to do, in plain prose, constraints in the same sentence, e.g. 'support email for a team of six, on our own server, under $100 a month'.
